notes.text:
Third-order Butterworth filter:
- Created butterworth_45hz.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch and exported butterworth_45hz.net through KiCad in /home/cua/kicad_project/. Final step 82 shows no title star and explicit saved status.
- Built buffered RC followed by equal-component Sallen-Key using U1A/U1B of LM358; U1C carries +/-12V. R1-R3=10k; C1-C3=0.352uF; R4/R5=1k. Nominal fc=45.214Hz, Q=1, DC gain=2. These are design calculations, not simulation results.
- Place all units in chooser reliably places A/B/C under U1. Default LM358 orientation has non-inverting input above inverting input. A pins 3+/2-/1out; B pins 5+/6-/7out; C pins 8+/4-.
- One r rotates default R or C with pin1 left; x mirrors horizontal R to pin1 right. Rotate that mirrored resistor once for R5 pin1 up. Enable pin numbers in properties for visual auditing.
- ERC step77 reported only 3 undriven power nets (#PWR05 GND, #PWR01 +12V, #PWR02 -12V), 0 warnings. No PWR_FLAG added, consistent with committed design. Visual audit matches intent; exported netlist not independently parsed.
- Export: clear ERC markers (440,722), close (605,722), File (10,58), hover Export (83,192), click Netlist (198,219). KiCad tab selected; Export (650,774); check filename/directory; Save (757,913); Ctrl+S clears export-induced title star.
- Prior simple edits and empty netlist scored 1.00; full circuit designs ranged 0.00-0.67. Scores support GUI save/export recipes but not exact reference agreement. Current task has no score yet.
